entities.summary: Dame Emma Natasha Walmsley is a British business executive, who was the chief executive of GSK from April 2017 until 31 December 2025. Before GSK, she worked for L'Oréal for 17 years, and was a non-executive director of Diageo until September 2016. Walmsley is also a non-executive director of Microsoft.
